statement: S103 (owner authorisation 2026-10-20: 'Store reproducible seeds and minimized counterexamples'). Fixed fast-check seeds of the property tests in tests/s103_rule_admission.test.ts and tests/s103_request_semantics.test.ts: a run with the same seed generates the same cases, and a failure reports its seed and path for exact replay. Counterexamples fast-check found and shrank during development are recorded below, each with the change it led to and the example test that now keeps it.

counterexamples.test: tests/s103_request_semantics.test.ts#property: two minimums apply the larger, in any unit
counterexamples.input: A kettle of at least 8383 ml and at least 1 litres.
counterexamples.failure: the applied limit's base value was 8.383000000000001 l (floating-point conversion of ml), not 8.383 l
counterexamples.change: baseValue253 rounds the base value to 12 significant digits (src/phase253_request_constraints.ts); the same canonical value feeds the request_combination limit facts
counterexamples.keptBy: tests/s103_request_semantics.test.ts#units are normalised before limits are compared
